meta.question: If the request maps to one catalog command on the switch, which one? Note the confusable pairs: disable_port shuts the interface (link AND power go down) while configure_poe_mode only turns PoE power off or on with the link left up; configure_access_vlan puts an access port in ONE untagged VLAN while configure_trunk_allowed_vlans makes a trunk with an allowed-VLAN list; show_vlan_config lists per-port VLAN settings while show_vlan_membership lists each VLAN's member ports.
